events.text:
Los resúmenes no proporcionan un ranking autorizado de los cinco genes más asociados con hipertensión primaria. El estudio TWAS identificó 1010 genes asociados tras corrección FDR y destaca RBM6, HLA-DRB5, UHRF1BP1, LYZ y TMEM116 por vía autoinmune. Como inferencia provisional, esos son candidatos relevantes, no un top cinco definitivo. Otro trabajo se centra en aldosteronismo primario, con WNT2B como señal más fuerte, distinto de hipertensión primaria.

Síntesis inicial basada en resúmenes recuperados; la verificación detallada sigue en curso.

claims.text: Considere que RBM6, HLA-DRB5, UHRF1BP1, LYZ y TMEM116 se reportan asociados a hipertensión y a autoinmunidad.

geneticContext.gene: RBM6, HLA-DRB5, UHRF1BP1, LYZ, and TMEM116

claims.quote: five of the genes ( RBM6, HLA-DRB5, UHRF1BP1, LYZ, and TMEM116 ) were associated with autoimmune system

claims.text: Valore que 1010 genes no solapados se asociaron significativamente con hipertensión tras corrección FDR en cuatro tejidos.

geneticContext.model: left heart ventricle, aorta, whole blood, and peripheral blood

claims.quote: 1010 non-overlapping genes expression were significantly associated with hypertension after FDR correction (PFDR <0.05) in four tissues (left heart ventricle, aorta, whole blood, and peripheral blood)

claims.text: Considere que se identificaron 15 genes nuevos de susceptibilidad a hipertensión en todos los tejidos.
claims.quote: Moreover, 15 novel hypertension-susceptible genes were identified in all tissues

claims.text: Considere que el TWAS usó pesos de expresión de ventrículo izquierdo, aorta y sangre.

geneticContext.model: left heart ventricle, aorta, whole blood, and peripheral blood

claims.quote: we used the gene expression weights for the left heart ventricle, aorta, whole blood, and peripheral blood as references

claims.text: Tenga en cuenta que la mayoría de SNPs de GWAS están en regiones intergénicas sin función clara.
claims.quote: the most associated single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) markers of GWAS are not located in or near genes but rather in intergenic regions

claims.text: Considere 15 genes susceptibles a hipertensión identificados por TWAS en cuatro tejidos, incluidos GFPT1, RBM6 y ZNF589.
claims.quote: Finally, 15 novel hypertension-susceptible genes were identified by TWAS in all tissues, and they were Glutamine-Fructose-6-Phosphate Transaminase 1 (GFPT1), RNA-binding motif protein 6 (RBM6), Zinc Finger Protein 589 (ZNF589),

claims.text: Considere que cinco genes TWAS de hipertensión (RBM6, HLA-DRB5, UHRF1BP1, LYZ y TMEM116) se asocian con autoinmunidad.
claims.quote: Five TWAS-identified genes ( RBM6, HLA-DRB5, UHRF1BP1, LYZ, and TMEM116 ) were identified to associate with autoimmunity by the combined search, which is shown in Table 2 .

claims.text: Considere valores P_FDR significativos para TNNT3 en cuatro tejidos, hasta 2.21E-12 en sangre total.
Considere que los datos GWAS son predominantemente de cohorte UK Biobank de ancestría europea, lo que limita generalización.
claims.quote: our results should be used with caution as the GWAS data in this study are predominantly from the UK Biobank cohort with European ancestry, therefore, limiting the generalisability of the findings.

claims.text: Considere que hay pocos estudios sobre los cinco genes hipertensivos relacionados con autoinmunidad y su vínculo no está elucidado.
claims.quote: there are few studies on the five autoimmune-related hypertension susceptibility genes identified by TWAS, and the link between them can not be well elucidated.

claims.text: Considere que este estudio integró GWAS de hipertensión de UK Biobank con expresión de ARNm para realizar TWAS en cuatro tejidos.
claims.quote: we integrated the GWAS datasets of hypertension from the UK Biobank and mRNA expression profiling together to complete a TWAS in four tissues

claims.text: Considere que los resultados apoyan que un mecanismo autoinmune tiene un papel importante en el desarrollo de hipertensión.
claims.quote: our results support that an autoimmune mechanism plays an important role in the development of hypertension.

claims.text: Considere que el metaanálisis identificó 5 loci significativos y 1 casi significativo, con la señal más fuerte en WNT2B en 1p13.
claims.quote: We identified 5 genome-wide association loci in the GWAS meta-analysis and 1 nearly genome-wide significant locus, which presented a significant association in the gene-based test.

claims.text: Evalúe que todos los loci de riesgo de PA mostraron efectos positivos sobre PA frente a hipertensión tras ajustar por medición de PA.

geneticContext.measurement: case-case association test between PA and hypertension
geneticContext.effect: significantly positive effects on PA against hypertension

claims.quote: all the PA risk-associated loci identified in this study showed significantly positive effects on PA against hypertension in the case-case association test between PA and hypertension even after adjustment for 1-time measurement of BP.

claims.text: Considere que la superposición de RXFP2 y LSP1 con otro GWAS europeo refuerza la fiabilidad de su asociación con PA.
claims.quote: RXFP2 and LSP1 were overlapped with the loci identified in this study, which enhances the reliability of their association with PA.

claims.text: Evalúe que las señales de PA colocalizaron fuertemente con efectos eQTL de RXFP2 en glándula suprarrenal.

geneticContext.measurement: eQTL effects in the adrenal gland
geneticContext.effect: strongly colocalized with the RXFP2 eQTL effects

claims.quote: Considering our findings that the PA association signals strongly colocalized with the RXFP2 eQTL effects in the adrenal gland

claims.text: Considere que, salvo RXFP2, los loci no alcanzaron significación genómica en cohorte individual, lo que impide un ranking universal.

geneticContext.effect: did not satisfy the genome-wide significance threshold in a single cohort, except for the RXFP2 locus

claims.quote: First, the PA risk-associated loci identified in the current study did not satisfy the genome-wide significance threshold in a single cohort, except for the RXFP2 locus.

claims.text: Considere que definiciones y pruebas confirmatorias distintas entre cohortes pueden sesgar estimaciones del metaanálisis.
claims.quote: we note the different definitions and guideline of the phenotypes (including confirmatory tests for PA) between cohorts, which might introduce biased estimates in our meta-analysis.

claims.text: Considere que WNT2B, HOTTIP, LSP1, TBX3 y RXFP2 fueron los genes más cercanos a loci significativos en el metaanálisis transancestral de aldosteronismo primario.
claims.quote: for which the genes nearest to the lead variants were WNT2B , HOTTIP , LSP1 , TBX3 , and RXFP2 , respectively ( P <5.0×10 −8 ; Figures 1 B and 2 ; Table 2 ; Figure S4 ).

claims.text: Valore la evidencia génica MAGMA que apoya CYP11B2/GML además del análisis de marcador único.
claims.quote: In addition, we identified significant associations for the genes CYP11B2/GML ( P =7.2×10 −7 and 5.3×10 −7 , respectively).

claims.text: Considere que la asociación japonesa rs9354826 no se replicó en UKB ni FinnGen, lo que dificulta un ranking universal.
claims.quote: The association of rs9354826 (6q12), which was observed in the Japanese GWAS, was not replicated in the UKB and FinnGen cohorts ( P >0.05).

claims.text: Note that 42 BP-associated variants from previous independent Japanese GWAS were investigated.
claims.quote: We investigated 42 BP-associated variants that have been established in previous independent Japanese GWAS ( Excel File S1 ).

claims.text: Consider 66.7% (28 of 42) showed higher ORs for PA risk than hypertension risk.
claims.quote: However, 66.7% (28 of 42) of the BP-associated variants presented higher ORs for the PA risk than for the hypertension risk

claims.text: Note simulation expected only 25.6% (95% CI, 12.5-38.6) to show higher ORs.
claims.quote: The simulation analysis estimated that the expected proportion of BP-associated variants having higher ORs for independent traits than for hypertension was only 25.6% (95% CI, 12.5−38.6).

claims.text: Note case-case analysis between PA and hypertension with BP adjustment was used.
claims.quote: we performed the case-case association analysis between PA and hypertension with the adjustment of BP to strictly compare the effects

claims.text: Consider 61.9% (26 of 42) showed higher effect on PA, rising to 80.0% (8 of 10).
claims.quote: Of all the variants, 61.9% (26 of 42) showed a higher effect on PA than on hypertension, and its proportion increased to 80.0% (8 of 10)

claims.text: Considere que el metaanálisis identificó 5 loci significativos y 1 casi significativo, con la señal más fuerte en WNT2B en 1p13.
claims.quote: We identified 5 genome-wide association loci in the GWAS meta-analysis and 1 nearly genome-wide significant locus, which presented a significant association in the gene-based test.

¿En qué poblaciones, muestras o diseños de estudio se observó cada asociación?
